en: Sepia-toned street view of a European city with a two‑storey neoclassical building lined with shops at street level and curtained windows above. Signs on the shops are in Cyrillic, including a prominent "КОНПАНIЯ ЗИНГЕРЪ" (Singer Company) sign. Pedestrians in early‑20th‑century dress walk along the sidewalk. The lower part of the image is overlaid with handwritten script. Printed German text at the bottom left identifies the scene, and a handwritten year appears at the lower right.
